hero_line: Nine specialized models. One electric-drive platform. Two energy strategies.
intro_note: Project Dynamo is an independent product strategy and vehicle design study. The Clark Motor Company is a fictional manufacturer and brand used to present the study from the perspective of an established automaker serving an existing base of customers, workers, dealers, suppliers, and communities. Dynamo is a scalable electric-drive architecture: shared hard points, interfaces, component families, energy bays, controls, production logic, and service knowledge support several kinds of vehicle and either battery-electric or Petro-Electric energy. The vehicles, specifications, performance figures, and business assumptions are conceptual and simulated. No actual manufacturer commissioned, sponsored, reviewed, or endorsed this work.
question_headline: How can an automaker offer real choice when the market keeps moving?
question_copy: A vehicle program takes years to develop and must remain useful for years after launch. Consumer taste, fuel prices, charging access, incentives, regulations, and political priorities can move much faster. Project Dynamo asks how an established manufacturer can offer genuinely different vehicles while protecting customers and the company from those swings.
shoe_headline: Not every vehicle needs to be shaped like an expensive basketball shoe.
shoe_copy: The American new-vehicle market now offers remarkable variation within a narrow range of forms. SUVs and pickups remain useful, but their dominance has crowded out sedans, hatches, wagons, coupes, minivans, and other bodies that still answer real needs. Dynamo treats body style as a functional decision rather than a fashion imposed by the platform beneath it.
swing_headline: The market swings faster than a vehicle program can turn.
swing_copy: Fuel prices rise and fall. Incentives and efficiency rules change with political priorities. Charging access expands unevenly. Buyers move between economy, space, and visible capability. Dynamo gives the manufacturer two ways to respond: change the mix of bodies and change the mix of onboard energy without discarding the electric-drive system underneath them.
platform_definition: Dynamo is a scalable electric-drive architecture: shared hard points, interfaces, component families, energy bays, controls, production logic, and service knowledge support specialized vehicles without treating one invariant floorpan as the answer for every body.
petro_electric_definition: Petro-Electric (PE) is Project Dynamo's product term for a plug-in series hybrid. An onboard prime mover turns a generator, the generator supplies electricity, and electric traction motors alone drive the wheels.
power_cassette_definition: The PE Power Cassette is a compact, production-installed prime mover and generator assembly with standardized electrical, control, cooling, fuel, emissions, and service interfaces to the Forward Energy Bay. It supplies electricity to the traction battery and motors and has no mechanical connection to the wheels.
specialization_claim: Derivatives and changes in the PE / BEV production mix retain the shared architecture, interfaces, component families, assembly logic, and service knowledge. Body-specific tooling, crash structure, cooling, plumbing, packaging, and capacity remain deliberately engineered for each vehicle.

palette.material_note: The cabin system supports smooth and woven variation, vegan leather alternatives, real leather, durable textiles, and mixed-material interiors within a defined architecture.

precedents.name: Ford Transit Custom PHEV
precedents.summary: Ford's 2019 plug-in van drove its front wheels exclusively with an electric motor; its 1.0-liter gasoline engine acted as a range extender.

precedents.name: Li Auto L series
precedents.summary: Li Auto has commercialized a family of extended-range electric SUVs while developing battery-electric platforms in parallel.

precedents.name: Edison Motors heavy trucks
precedents.summary: Edison's Class 8 vocational trucks pair an onboard diesel generator with electric drive axles, carrying the rail-like series electric logic into demanding road work.

precedents.name: Scout Traveler and Terra with Harvester
precedents.summary: Scout plans the Traveler and Terra with either a full battery-electric system or a Harvester generator that recharges the high-voltage battery without mechanically driving the wheels.

precedents.name: Stellantis STLA Frame
precedents.summary: Stellantis describes STLA Frame as a scalable, BEV-native multi-energy architecture for full-size trucks and SUVs, including BEV and range-extended electric configurations.

precedents.name: Ford Universal EV Platform
precedents.summary: Ford's flexible electric platform and production system are intended to underpin multiple body styles, beginning with a midsize electric pickup targeted for 2027.

precedents.name: Rivian R2 and R3
precedents.summary: Rivian's distinct R2 SUV and R3 crossover share a midsize platform, structural battery unit, drivetrain technology, network architecture, and software stack.

precedent_conclusion: These programs prove different parts of the case. Series-electric vehicles show how an onboard generator can extend electric drive. Scout and STLA Frame already pair battery-electric and range-extended configurations, while Rivian and Ford show how shared electric architecture can support distinct products. Dynamo brings those strands together across nine specialized models and makes body variety and PE / BEV flexibility part of the system from the beginning.
future_note: Illustrative platform possibilities only; not announced products or a complete roadmap.
closing: Time after time, you'll have everything you need in a Clark.
